summary: Housing reasons are the most often cited cause of a move.
realLife: In the 2017 survey, housing-related reasons led the list of why people moved, ahead of family and employment.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, Overall Mover Rate Remains at an All-time Low (2017): https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2017/12/lower-moving-rate.html
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (move/moved-in with its pushedBy fact). needs: a housing reason beside the economy one.

turns.what: The family stays put for years, and the move that is told never happens.
turns.pulledBy: owning the home and a steady job
turns.writesBack: no move event, so the loading story skips the section
